description: Fully-threaded hex-head bolt per ISO 4017: a hexagonal head (width across flats s, height k jointly locked to the nominal thread diameter, shared with the ISO 4014 hex-head table) whose top is washed by a conical chamfer to a circle inscribed in the hexagon (the standard hex-head washout); a fillet under the head where it meets the shank; and a shank of nominal ISO 888 length carrying a modelled external metric thread (ISO 261 coarse pitch) rendered as a real single-start helical V-groove running the full length, leaving a short unthreaded run-out under the head, and a 45-degree lead-in chamfer at the threaded end (ISO 4753). Covers M6-M24.
source: ISO 4017 (hexagon head screws, full thread); hex-head dimension table s/k per ISO 4014; ISO 888 nominal length series; ISO 261 coarse thread diameters + coarse pitch series; ISO 4753 chamfered thread end
